proof_body:
by
  intro f a K hf hnn hK
  have hfi : ∀ t : ℝ, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioc a t) := fun t =>
    ((hf.mono Set.Icc_subset_Ici_self).integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc).mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hI : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi a) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.integrableOn_Ioi_of_intervalIntegral_norm_bounded K a hfi Filter.tendsto_id ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop a] with t ht
    have h1 : ∫ x in a..t, ‖f x‖ = ∫ x in a..t, f x := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx => ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at hx
      exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (hnn x hx.1)
    show ∫ x in a..t, ‖f x‖ ≤ K
    rw [h1]
    exact hK t ht
  exact ⟨_, MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Ioi a hI Filter.tendsto_id⟩
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a K : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici a) → (∀ x, a ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ t, a ≤ t → ∫ x in a..t, f x ≤ K) → ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ x in a..t, f x) Filter.atTop (nhds L)
